title: Honor a serial dependency chain despite available capacity

rubric.text: Chooses solo once for the whole serial graph: the lead self-reviews and commits SCHEMA, passes affected checks at the integrated head before WRITER, then READER, without worker slots or separate task acceptance.
Recognizes shared-file and unmerged-code overlap makes concurrent execution unsafe despite isolated worktrees
Keeps implementation and repair ownership with the lead for this solo run and retains mandatory independent final review.
